energy_interpretation.cohesive_increment: independent exact piecewise-linear law integral, checked against primitive cumulative-work differences
energy_interpretation.total_balance: control path work checked against Delta(U_bulk + cohesive stored + cohesive dissipated)

limitations: fixed-face global Mode-I opening-control toy history
no autonomous growth or crack advance
